note: Forbidden: stopping, or sending anything but a Reset Query, after No Data Available with no other cache. TestRFC6810NoDataAvailableRepeatsResetQuery runs one live cache that answers two queries with Error Report code 2 and asserts three consecutive received queries are pduResetQuery, each within 4s (t.Fatal on silence, assert.Equal on a Serial Query). Negative: once the cache supplies a load the route validates and the next query is pduSerialQuery, so the reset mode ends at the usable load.
